prerequisites: Ability to read and comprehend documentation written in English.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to model, design, define the architecture, implement, manage, operate, administer, and maintain applications, networks, systems, services, and computer content.
Understand the life cycles of products and services.
Understand the frameworks, methodologies, and standards applied in the life cycle of a product or service.
Know how to design, implement, and maintain a product or service.
Know how to audit the operation, design, and implementation of a product or service.

syllabus_topics: Methodologies and frameworks for product development and maintenance
Standards for product development and maintenance
Methodologies, frameworks, and standards for services. Certification and auditing in IT service management
teaching_methods: Participation in debate forums on the virtual campus

assessment_methods.method: Team work (product specification and IT service management, memory submission and public defense)
Individual participation (in debate forums on the virtual campus)

assessment_rules: To pass the course, each of the two parts (team work and individual participation) must be passed with a grade of at least 5 points out of 10. The final grade is calculated as 0.8 * Team Work + 0.2 * Individual Participation. If the minimum grade is not reached in any part, the final grade will be the minimum between the formula's result and 4.5. For extraordinary calls, evaluation consists of a presential knowledge test and the ordinary call grade; the knowledge test must be passed with at least 5 points for the final grade to be 0.6 * Knowledge Test + 0.4 * Ordinary Call Grade. If the minimum is not met, the final grade is the minimum between the formula's result and 4.5.
